result.summary: Prepares the 30.x maintenance branch for the v30.5 point release and backports PR #35878 to process only unique transaction inventory advertisements. It also bumps the project version to v30.5 and updates manual pages and release notes.
result.problem: Nodes running the 30.x release branch do spurious processing work when receiving conflicting or duplicate transaction INV messages that cannot both enter the mempool. In addition, the 30.x branch lacks the release metadata, documentation, and version bump needed to cut the v30.5 maintenance release.
evidence: Commit 1bb5289d48 states: 'There is no reason we should process conflicting advertisements for transactions, as they cannot be both accepted into our mempool. Avoid processing these and doing spurious work.'
result.scope_notes: Combines a backported P2P network processing change (#35878) with standard release preparation commits (version bump, manpages, release notes) targeted at the 30.x maintenance branch.
result.card: Prepares the 30.x branch for the v30.5 release by backporting PR #35878 and bumping version numbers and release documentation. It stops 30.x nodes from performing spurious work when receiving conflicting transaction INVs that cannot both enter the mempool. As noted in the commit message, processing duplicate or conflicting transaction advertisements wastes resources because conflicting transactions cannot both be accepted into the mempool.
uncertainties: Diff was not provided in the PR payload, so the exact backport implementation details cannot be verified directly.

risk.why: A flaw in backported transaction INV processing could cause nodes running v30.5 to drop valid transaction announcements or mishandle peer inventory messages.
